title: Catalogue summary of a tool description

request.goal: An MCP tool's description is the Python string '  Fetch a page.Returns   HTML!  Use it with care.' (note the spaces). What exact string does _summary(description) return?

code.title: scripts/mcp_registry.py excerpt (_summary)

pass: "Fetch a page.Returns HTML!": the whitespace runs collapse to single spaces, and the split needs whitespace after the punctuation, so "page.Returns" does not end the first sentence.
fail: "Fetch a page.Returns HTML! Use it with care."
